title: Document builder whose ordering cannot be got wrong
task: Implement a `doc` package that produces a plain-text document: a header (the title, then a line of `=` the same length), any number of paragraphs separated by blank lines, and a footer that is the single word `end`. The header must come before any paragraph and the footer last; make that impossible to get wrong through the types rather than by documenting it. The finished document comes out as a string.
